items.context: Chewsday Innit? (I couldn’t help it 😸) What’s your go to “cozy” game? Or what game do you find truly “endless” in terms of enjoyment playing?
items.text: Stardew Valley is the classic answer. It's easy to play in short sessions and the seasons keep it feeling fresh for years.
